title: Fanny Caroline Lefroy
dates: (1820-1885)
---

great-niece of Jane Austen, contributor to MP

She published Long Long Ago, Ralph Wolfford and My Three Aunts and other works in MP. The Miss Lefroy mentioned (15 Jan 1853) as a friend of Mary Anne Dyson may be her too. [Discussed in L.A.de Gruchy London University thesis; OLIS; Le Faye, Jane Austen's Letters]
